thread.title: Facebook forming chip unit: report - MarketWatch

author: Max A. Cherney
title: Facebook forming chip unit: report - MarketWatch
text: Facebook Inc. FB, -1.36% is putting together a unit to design chips for the company, according to a Bloomberg report . Facebook stock is up a fraction in the extended session after closing down 1.4% to $166.36 during regular trading. Citing anonymous sources and job postings, Bloomberg said that the social media giant is looking for personnel who would be suited for building chips that it might use in its hardware devices and data centers which power, among other things, its artificial intelligence efforts. The Menlo Park, Calif.-based company's interest in producing their own chips mirrors that of other tech giants such as Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, -0.37% [s:goog] and Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.22% Facebook stock is up 5.7% this year, as the benchmark S&P 500 SPX, +0.08% index has gained 1.2%.
